ModMetaData.name: Tech Trader Prevention
ModMetaData.author: SummerSausages2TTV
ModMetaData.description:
Restrict trader factions and purchases to your colony's technology level. Determine colony tech from researched projects, configurable tier-completion thresholds, your faction, or a manual override. Customize trade channels, tier allowances, and individual modded definitions.
Optional equipment salvage can break equipped weapons and worn apparel on death, downing, or both into definition-based crafting materials. Configure affected pawn groups, per-item break chance, fixed or randomized material survival, and protected gear.
Harmony is required. No DLC is required. Quest-linked trader identities, currency, relics, biocoded gear, and quest-tagged equipment are protected by default. Salvage is disabled until enabled in settings.
This is the source-based 2.0 rewrite. Disable both legacy Prevent/Replace Higher Tech Traders variants before enabling it.
